objective: Benchmark Project SkyNet Heavy-Lifter v2 fleet internal cost structures against global commercial drone delivery standards, incorporating regulatory and consumer constraints from internal documents.
decision_question: Should OmniLogistics proceed with the Heavy-Lifter v2 fleet mix as planned, or pivot to Swift-Class drones for urban centers to ensure regulatory compliance and cost efficiency?

children: Willingness to pay premium ($2.50 for 30-min delivery)

hypotheses.hypothesis: H1: Heavy-Lifter v2's 2.5 lbs overweight status will incur additional regulatory penalties or require costly exemptions, making Swift-Class more economical for urban corridors.
H2: The 35% cost reduction target ($4.10 to $2.66) is achievable with Swift-Class drones due to lower weight and compliance costs, despite higher per-unit volume.
H3: Consumer willingness to pay a $2.50 premium for 30-min delivery can offset the higher per-package cost of Swift-Class drones.
H4: Whisper-Prop technology deployment will mitigate noise concerns (42%) and improve acceptance, justifying investment in quieter drones.
